units.source_text: 這時，萬萬沒想到老家的大哥帶著比目魚前來接我出院，

en.t: At this point, quite unexpectedly, my eldest brother from home came with Hirame to take me out of the hospital,

units.source_text: 大哥仍如從前，用認真略帶嚴肅的語調告訴我：「父親在上個月末因胃潰瘍去世了，我們對你既往不咎，

en.t: and, just as before, he told me in an earnest, slightly stern tone, "Father died of a stomach ulcer at the end of last month. We will not hold your past against you,

units.source_text: 也不會讓你為生活操心，你什麼不做就可以，

en.t: and we will not make you worry about your livelihood. You do not have to do anything,

units.source_text: 但有一個前提條件，你必須得馬上離開眷戀不捨的東京，回家好好療養身體。

en.t: but there is one condition: you must leave Tokyo, however reluctant you may be, right away and go home to recover properly.

units.source_text: 你在東京惹下的禍，澀田先生都處理得差不多了，

en.t: Mr. Shibuta has taken care of most of the trouble you caused in Tokyo,
so you need not worry about it."

units.source_text: 突然覺得故鄉的山河浮現在眼前，我輕輕地點了點頭。

en.t: Suddenly feeling as if the mountains and rivers of my hometown had appeared before my eyes, I gave a faint nod.

units.source_text: 得知父親病故後，我變得越發萎靡不振。

en.t: After learning that my father had died of illness, I sank into even deeper listlessness.
